title: Surveying Walking Person
description: Articulated 3D surveying-field person with deterministic path, speed, height, and gait controls.
learningObjectives: Relate walking speed, elapsed time, and path distance in a surveying-field context.
Observe how gait phase and stopping behavior remain tied to one deterministic motion model.

rights.attribution: Original LearnMat procedural geometry; no third-party models or textures.

verification.notes: Rebuilt as real Three.js geometry. Source/model invariants reviewed; live rendered browser and assistive-technology evidence remains pending.
